name: github_agentic_probe
description:
Ultra-lean GitHub CLI integration for agentic workflows.
    Queries PRs, issues, CI workflow runs, or repository status using local 'gh' credentials.
    Consumes minimal tokens (<150 tokens) and avoids verbose web scraping.

    Args:
        query_type: 'status', 'prs', 'issues', or 'runs'.
        repo: Optional repository in 'owner/repo' format (defaults to current working repository).
        limit: Maximum number of items to return (default 5).
